description:
Refactor the 'LogisticsSystem' project in Eclipse to improve the class hierarchy.

The 'Transport' superclass currently contains tire-related logic that only belongs to the 'Truck' subclass. Ships and Drones do not have tires.

Your task:
1. Open the 'LogisticsSystem' project in Eclipse.
2. Open 'src/main/java/com/logistics/domain/Transport.java'.
3. Use Eclipse's Refactor > Push Down... feature to move:
   - The 'checkTirePressure()' method
   - The 'MAX_TIRE_PSI' constant
4. Push them down ONLY to the 'Truck' subclass (do not push to Ship or Drone).
5. Ensure the refactoring completes and the project still builds successfully.

Note: Using the automated refactoring tool is required to ensure references and imports are handled correctly.
